metaTitle: Fight Wrinkles With Dysport® - Victory Medical Services & Medical Spa

blocks.html: When it comes to wrinkles, one of the first areas that you are likely to notice lines develop is the forehead. It is one of the most animated areas of our face and is used when experiencing various emotions such as happy, surprised, sad, disappointed, angry, and the list goes on. Some people develop horizontal lines that stretch across the entire forehead, while others develop vertical lines that are in between the eyebrows and are often referred to as “bunny ears”.

Many people are not fond of having wrinkles appear on their face as it reminds them, they are getting older and they may also be concerned about how other perceive them. As an example, if one’s resting face has wrinkles that show frown lines, others might perceive them as upset or angry and may not feel the person is easy to approach.

Although you can try your best to eat healthy, limit alcohol use, and stay hydrated to have radiant and glowing skin, the true cause for the wrinkles are the muscles that lie beneath the skin. Therefore, it is important to invest in a treatment that will address the underlying issue. Dysport® is a protein-based product that is used to relax the muscles, so they are unable to contract the same way. In return, you will see less wrinkling when showing emotions.

Dysport® is a simple, yet effective, treatment that is convenient for those even with the busiest schedules. It is transformative as well and people often look refreshed and younger after receiving injections.
